name: East Route
descent_text: Descend the way you came. From the summit, downclimb the east-side gully and the low-exposure Class 3 cleft, then head back across the base of the summit block to the top of the boot path. Follow it down through both cliff bands, using the same gully on the right, and stay on the existing tread rather than cutting new lines through the loose scree. Watch for the exit where the boot path meets Rachel Lake Trail near the avalanche clearing; it is easy to miss in the trees. From there it is an easy walk of a little over two miles to the trailhead. No rappel is needed.
approach: Start at the Rachel Lake trailhead at the end of the Box Canyon road (FR 4930) and walk Rachel Lake Trail #1313 for about 2.2 miles, passing a brushy avalanche clearing where the summit block shows ahead. Just beyond it, watch on the right for the unmarked climbers' boot path that climbs steeply through timber and deadfall, mostly Class 2. It breaks out below a cliff band: pass the first cliffs on the right, work left around a rock outcrop, and take a gully on the right through the second cliffs. The path then leads up to the open slopes at about 6,250 ft below the summit block, where the East Route splits off to the right around the south and east sides. Expect roughly 3,800 to 3,900 ft of gain from the car.
